title: Writing Topsy on the train to Albany
summary: Rejoining the band, he wrote Topsy on the train to Albany and prepared a rough score so Harry Edison and others could read it at rehearsal.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But Basie's all right, but he always kept remembering what a hard time we had, and why should I work hard? I could hire somebody to write. And when I came back in the band, that's what he did. He said, now, Ed, you meet them in Albany, New York. I got the train and I went to Albany and I met the band.
And when I got there, I wrote Topsy on the train, on the way there. Sat down and just thought it, wrote it up

and got there, and they was already in rehearsal, out at the park. And I went out there and I had -- couldn't make no score because I didn't have time. I wanted to have something in rehearsal. And Harry Edison, those guys sat down and -- I made some score and they struck it off. And that's why they -- all embarrass Edgar so when they see him, because they wonder, how did he get on this sort of music?
